amount.description: What the investor paid, in the base currency.

approval_id.description: The approval request waiting, if one is.

checks.description: A draft's status: ✖ while no evidence is attached.

class_account_id.description: The share-capital account of the class it converts into.

class_id.description: The recorded class it converts into; left out, the account's first.

classification.description: The accountant's classification, liability or equity [verify per instrument]; left out until decided.

currency.description: The amount's currency, the base currency.

denominator.description: How its terms count the shares its price divides by: the company after the SAFEs convert, the shares before the round, or as the terms say, quoted in denominator_note.

denominator_note.description: With as_terms: how the terms count the shares.
examples: All shares, options granted and the unallocated pool, before the round

discount.description: A percentage off the round price, above 0 and below 100.

evidence.description: How many files are attached and not removed: asking for approval needs one, the signed instrument.

form.description: post_money_safe: a SAFE whose valuation cap counts the company after the SAFEs convert; pre_money_safe: one whose cap counts the shares before the round; discount_safe: a discount on the round price and no cap; mfn_safe: the best terms of a later instrument; convertible_note: a loan that converts, with interest and a maturity.

held.description: Once recorded: what 2700 Convertible notes / SAFE holds for it today, from the ledger: the money received under it, less what converted or was repaid (FR-EQ-18). Absent while the chart has no account of role convertible-instruments.

holder_id.description: The investor who holds it, a contact marked investor or shareholder. It stays once drafted.

interest_converts.description: A note's interest converts into shares with its principal.

interest_rate.description: A note's simple interest, a percentage a year.

price_decimals.description: The decimals the terms give the conversion price.

recorded_by.description: Who approved it, as it was recorded.

signed_on.description: The day both sides signed it.

status.description: draft: waiting for the signed instrument and approval; recorded: in the register.

template.description: The template its terms follow (listInstrumentTemplates), when one does.

template_enabled.description: Its template is enabled, so it can convert by itself when every term it has is one the template covers.

trigger.description: What converts it: the next priced round, its maturity, a liquidity event, or what the terms say.

valuation_cap.description: A capped SAFE's valuation cap, in the base currency.

version.description: The version of its content; with its status it makes the ETag.
